rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the place a journey or delivery is intended to reach.

example.english: Canada is the destination of this parcel.
example.traditional: 呢個包裹嘅目的地係加拿大。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 baau1 gwo2 ge3 muk6 dik1 dei6 hai6 gaa1 naa4 daai6

rows.note: Use this specifically when stressing the endpoint or finish of a journey rather than its intended destination.

example.english: We can only stop when we reach the destination.
example.traditional: 我哋要跑到終點先可以停低。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 paau2 dou3 zung1 dim2 sin1 ho2 ji5 ting4 dai1
